welcome:
Welcome! You're subscribed to free crypto Spot + Perps signals on up to 350 of the most traded coins on OKX, plus a short list of 24h hot movers and on-chain spot picks.

Signals use the chart plus catalysts: token unlocks, open interest and funding, TVL, fees and DEX volume, and sector strength. Hot movers are separate: a coin up hard in 24 hours with a volume spike can signal even if it is not in the chart list yet. Each signal says why in plain words, with an entry, stop loss and 3 take-profits. Perps signals suggest at most 3x leverage. Every result is tracked on the website:
https://govigovi1.github.io/signals/

Not financial advice. These are paper-tracked signals: nothing is traded for you. You can lose money, and leverage makes losses bigger and faster.

Nobody from this bot will ever ask for your keys, seed phrase or money.
